component.name: WinBridge
component.summary: Build and run Windows apps from Linux, without leaving Linux

description.p: WinBridge cross-compiles Windows binaries from Go, Rust, .NET, C/C++ and Flutter projects and checks every artifact for a real Windows PE32+ header before calling a build a success. Native cross-compilers are used wherever the language allows it; Flutter, which needs Visual Studio and only runs on Windows, is built on a headless VM this tool drives over SSH.

It also runs existing Windows programs: `winbridge run app.exe` launches a Windows binary through a managed Wine runtime this tool downloads and verifies itself, with an isolated prefix per app, optional DXVK for Direct3D-over-Vulkan rendering, and winetricks for extra runtimes an app needs. No system Wine, no root, nothing to configure by hand.
This is a command-line tool. There is no window to open — run `flatpak run io.github.dhiva_labs.WinBridge --help` from a terminal to get started.
See the project's GitHub releases page for the full changelog.
